ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85-90% high-intensity white pixels on the internal ventral surface versus 10-15% low-intensity black pixels localized to the perimeter and peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central field. Continuous low-intensity black boundary along the leading and trailing edges. Discrete low-intensity circular blob located in the lower-central region of the left lobe. Irregular low-intensity dendritic pattern at the central peduncle base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks at the distal tips of both lobes with pixel-amplitude variations exceeding the mean edge width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves on the trailing edges meeting at the median notch; leading edges exhibit a slight convex curvature toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, low-relief indentations scattered across the white ventral surface, consistent with post-attachment barnacle sites. Two distinct high-contrast dark circular clusters near the vertical axis of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Circular scarring scattered across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent low-intensity circular spot isolated on the left lobe's mid-section.
